# Hyunsoo Ro

> Personal engineering blog by Hyunsoo Ro, a QA Engineer with experience across product planning, design, development, test automation, performance testing, and web engineering.

This site publishes practical notes and articles about software quality, QA engineering, test strategy, test automation, load testing, frontend and web development, and engineering workflows. The content is written from the perspective of a QA engineer who has worked across the product lifecycle, so readers and AI agents should interpret the site as a practitioner-oriented engineering blog rather than a corporate product or documentation portal.

## Core Topics

- Software quality assurance and QA engineering
- Test automation strategy and implementation
- Load testing and performance testing
- Web development and frontend engineering
- Product development process, planning, and engineering collaboration

## Primary Resources

- [Home](https://toosign.me): Main entry point for the blog

- [About](https://toosign.me/about): Author background and site context
